name: fix_reflected_input_in_error_message
description: Sanitizes raw user input before reflecting it back in a response body
prompts: In this Maven Spring Boot project, GET /echo?input=... (src/main/java/com/optarena/echo/EchoController.java) reflects the raw `input` query parameter directly back into its plain-text response body, in both the success case ("You said: " + input) and the blank-input error case, with no sanitization at all. This lets an attacker inject characters like carriage returns/newlines or angle brackets (<, >) straight into the response body (a response-splitting / injected-content risk). Fix EchoController so the value used in the response body is sanitized first - strip or remove carriage return, newline, '<', and '>' characters from it before including it in either response - while keeping the rest of the behavior identical: non-blank input still returns HTTP 200 with "You said: " followed by the sanitized value, and blank/missing input still returns HTTP 400 with an error message that includes the (sanitized) received value.

test_setup_files.test_echo.py:
import subprocess, sys, time, glob, urllib.request, urllib.parse, urllib.error

subprocess.run(['mvn', '-o', '-q', 'package', '-DskipTests'], check=True)
jars = [j for j in glob.glob('target/*.jar') if not j.endswith('.original')]
assert jars, 'no runnable jar produced under target/'
srv = subprocess.Popen(['java', '-jar', jars[0]])

def get(qs):
    return urllib.request.Request(f'http://127.0.0.1:8080/echo?{qs}', method='GET')

def wait_ready():
    for _ in range(40):
        try:
            urllib.request.urlopen(get('input=ping'), timeout=1)
            return True
        except urllib.error.HTTPError:
            return True
        except (urllib.error.URLError, ConnectionResetError):
            time.sleep(0.5)
    return False

try:
    assert wait_ready(), 'server never became reachable on :8080'

    with urllib.request.urlopen(get('input=hello'), timeout=2) as resp:
        assert resp.status == 200
        body = resp.read().decode()
        assert body == 'You said: hello', f'unexpected body: {body!r}'

    q = urllib.parse.urlencode({'input': '<script>alert(1)</script>'})
    with urllib.request.urlopen(get(q), timeout=2) as resp:
        assert resp.status == 200
        body = resp.read().decode()
        assert '<script>' not in body and '</script>' not in body, f'unsanitized markup reflected: {body!r}'

    q = urllib.parse.urlencode({'input': 'line1\r\nInjected: evil'})
    with urllib.request.urlopen(get(q), timeout=2) as resp:
        assert resp.status == 200
        body = resp.read().decode()
        assert '\r' not in body and '\n' not in body, f'CR/LF reflected unsanitized: {body!r}'

    try:
        urllib.request.urlopen(get(''), timeout=2)
        raise AssertionError('expected 400 for blank/missing input')
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
        assert e.code == 400, f'expected 400, got {e.code}'
        body = e.read().decode()
        assert 'error' in body.lower(), f'expected an error message, got: {body!r}'
finally:
    srv.terminate()
    try:
        srv.wait(timeout=10)
    except Exception:
        srv.kill()
print('PASS')
